svg.aria-label: A latitude-longitude image twice as wide as tall: u runs 0 to 1 across, where the horizon faces -Z, +X, +Z, -X and -Z again at longitudes +180, +90, 0, -90 and -180 degrees, and v runs from 0 straight up (+Y) through 0.5 at the horizon to 1 straight down (-Y). The direction (1, 1, 0) / sqrt 2 lands at u = v = 0.25.
